D10's docstring describes the intended bridge-then-taper architecture correctly -- the dispatch arbitrator does not yet implement it. See DR-2026-09-02-BESS-POLICY. Do not remove this xfail by loosening the test's assertions; remove it only once a reserve-preservation dispatch policy is implemented and specified.
